name: look_up_word
description: Look up an English word in Spelling Bee Hive's catalogue of more than a hundred thousand words: its correct spelling, a pronunciation guide, part of speech, language of origin, definitions and an example sentence, its Spelling Bee Hive difficulty level and practice set, and any spelling bee it was a winning word in.

arguments.name: word
arguments.desc: The word to look up, for example "accommodate" or "bromocriptine".

name: practice_words
description: Get words to quiz a speller on, picked at random from one of Spelling Bee Hive's free practice sets at the chosen difficulty: levels 1-3 are School, 4-6 Advanced and 7-9 Champion, where 1 is the easiest and 9 is national-final difficulty.

arguments.name: level
arguments.desc: Difficulty level, a whole number from 1 (easiest) to 9 (hardest).

arguments.name: count
arguments.desc: How many words to return, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 10.

name: winning_words
description: Winning words of past spelling bees, newest first: the national championship back to 1925 and national and regional bees around the world, each with a link to the word's page.

arguments.name: competition
arguments.desc: Part of a competition's name, for example "Scripps". Optional.

arguments.name: year
arguments.desc: Only winners from this year, for example 2024. Optional.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many winners to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

name: words_of_the_year
description: Each major English dictionary's Word of the Year for a year, with how to say it, what it means and a spelling tip.

arguments.name: year
arguments.desc: The year, for example 2025. Defaults to the most recent year.

name: trending_words
description: Words people have recently been searching for how to spell, say or define, grouped by topic, each with a short spelling tip and a link to its page.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: How many words to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.
